description: `.throw()` escapes however clean the iterator is, and whatever the member it lands on does — a hand-written one that swallows included. It is the consumer choosing to throw, with a detour, and a throw cannot be laundered through an iterator.

diagnostics.message: `.throw()` escapes this `@nothrow` function: it throws the value into the iterator, whatever the iterator makes of it — a throw cannot be laundered through one. Bridge it with `try`/`catch`.
